items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: And I used to get the drummer, he used to go out of town with me, George used to go with me

ctx.x: Yeah, right about across. It's a light. Well we played there. And I used to get the drummer, he used to go out of town with me, George used to go with me, and I used to send Albert Fernandez, you know him? Yeah. I used to send him over there. Yeah. I'd send him over there and play in my place sometimes. I had to go fulfill my job somewhere, like Mobile somewhere, I had to go and play. So we made good money on that coast. But see, O.G. Associates, every night I played over there, he wouldn't give me a nickel. See,…
